subject: New Module Assignment - $module_code
body:
Dear $instructor_name,

You have been assigned to teach a module in the university schedule system.

=== Module Assignment Details ===

Module: $module_code - $module_name
Session Type: $session_type

Schedule:
- Day: $day_of_week
- Time: $start_time - $end_time
- Room: $room_location

Number of Enrolled Students: $student_count

=== Your Responsibilities ===

- Teach the scheduled sessions at the specified time and location
- Prepare course materials and assessments
- Maintain regular office hours for student consultation
- Submit grades according to the academic calendar
- Report any scheduling conflicts immediately

=== Resources Available ===

- Course materials: Available on the learning management system
- Teaching resources: contact teaching.support@university.edu
- Technical support: contact it.support@university.edu
- Academic calendar: www.university.edu/calendar

=== Important Notes ===

- Please confirm receipt of this email within 24 hours
- Review the module syllabus and learning outcomes
- Contact the Head of Department if you have any concerns about this assignment

=== Contact Information ===

- Head of Department: $hod_email
- Academic Office: academic.office@university.edu
- Timetabling Office: timetable@university.edu

If you have any conflicts with this schedule or questions about the module, please contact the academic office immediately.

Welcome to the teaching team!

$signature
